item.tib: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam rgyud bskul
item.coloph: ces bon skyongs thugs dam rgyud bskul 'di nas dpal ldan lo cu'i dgon gyi bla brang pho drang bskyed tshal du dbra rigs nyid kyi rjes 'jugs dri dbon phun tshogs rgyal mtshan bstan 'dzin gyi lcags yos zla ba lnga pa'i dkar phyogs dga' ba gsum pa'i snga cha la pa'i yal 'dabs ldem pa'i gar bsgyur ba'i dges legs phel
item.note: the information from the colophon about the transmission of this teaching reads as follows (fol. 9r5): ces bya ste / dbyings nas thugs dam gyis brgyud bskul ba'o / gyer spung dran pa nam mkha'i lung don / sdang chen dmu tsha gyer med gyi bsnyan brgyud / sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i dngos grub / rjes 'jugs skal ldan skyes bu'i bkol byang / phyi rabs bsgrubs pa po'i spyod yul / dam can bsrungs ma rnams kyi 'phrin las / rdzogs so / dag go / [?] sa ma ya / rgya rgya rgya / bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par shogs.
